newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mixed, light ends buoyant.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mixed, light ends buoyant.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mixed on Wednesday with light ends showing particular strength.
Naphtha rose as traders bought swaps here and sold the paper market in Japan on rumours that up to eight cargoes could be leaving the Med for the Far East.
Gasoline barges rose $3 to $203/$205 for Eurograde, with light support from an unexpected drop in U.S. inventories.
Gas oil fell by up to $4 a tonne due to sharply lower futures and shaky premiums for certain grades.
High sulphur fuel oil was steady while low sulphur cargoes were slightly firmer.
